what_this_is: WP-D15 step 7 (ruling R20): words that state a number without digits. A shown answer that uses one is logged to logs/citation_failures.jsonl (kind number_words_shown); the answer is never refused for it. Matched as whole words, any case; a hyphen in an entry also matches a space. 'quarter' is not counted after one of quarter_not_after (the standing phrase 'in the lowest quarter of the 6,800'). Edit this list, not the code.
